entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I hope you can help me. I need to return something, and I'm just so disappointed about the whole thing.

I'm certainly sorry to hear that. I'll do my best to help. To start, could you tell me which item you're calling about? And could you clarify, is it a technical fault with the item or more of a preference issue?

It's the Pro-Vent jersey I ordered. It's not a fault, it's just... I finally got around to trying it on for a big ride I have coming up, and it's the wrong size. It's just way too tight across the chest.
I understand. So the fit isn't right. Let me pull up your account. Can you please confirm the order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Yes, it's sarah.gomez@email.com. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I've never had this happen. I just feel so let down. I saved up for this specific jersey and now I can't even wear it.

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here. It looks like the jersey was delivered about 42 days ago. I want to assure you, this is no problem at all. For a standard item like this jersey, you are well within our 90-day return policy.
Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried it was too late. I was really counting on that money back if I couldn't get a different one. Are you sure?
Absolutely. We can definitely process a return for a full refund, or if you'd prefer, we can set up an exchange for the next size up. Whatever works best for you.
Wow, that's... that's such a relief. Thank you, David. I think I'd like to do an exchange, if that's okay. I really do love the jersey itself.

Of course. And I see here that you're a VIP Gold member with us, Sarah. Thank you for being such a great customer. As a little apology for the sizing issue, I've gone ahead and emailed you a pre-paid return label, and I've also added a 20% discount code to your account for any future purchase. No expiration.
You did? Oh my gosh, that's so nice of you! That completely makes my day. An exchange for a large would be perfect.

Excellent. I have processed the exchange for a size large. Just use that label to send back the jersey that was too tight, and we'll get the new one shipped out to you right away. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been incredibly helpful. Thank you again, David.
You are very welcome, Sarah. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great ride!
